ballPolicy: Separate Accu-specific ball tracks her right-facing reverse layup, moves behind the turning shoulder, and releases at frame5/tick12. It is never painted into the pose sheet.

review.reviewNotes: Eight distinct complete human reverse-layup poses. Accu retains green eyes, blunt bangs, cropped sides, two long black twin ponytails and the teal/violet/black kit. Body turns toward a back/shoulder view and returns through a clean high reverse finish; single release is frame5/tick12. Canon mirror review pending.
